about.label: About
about.hero_bio_1: I build clean, tested and production-ready web applications. My focus is on code quality, component architecture and real-world use cases — not just making things look good on screen.
about.hero_bio_2: I approach frontend development the way a craftsman approaches a build — with attention to the foundation, not just the surface. TypeScript strict mode, shared validation schemas, E2E tests for critical paths — these aren't extras, they're how I work.
about.hero_bio_3: Currently looking for my first professional role where I can contribute to a real product, learn from a team, and keep improving.
about.approach_item_1_desc: I name things carefully, keep functions small, and write code as if the next developer is me in 6 months. Because it usually is.
about.approach_item_2_desc: Unit tests for pure logic, component tests for user interactions, E2E for critical flows. Tests tell the story of what the code is supposed to do.
about.approach_item_3_desc: Before writing a component, I think about where it lives, what it knows, and what it doesn't. Shared types and validation schemas from day one.
about.approach_item_4_desc: Perfect is the enemy of done. I ship, gather feedback, iterate. Portfolio v2 exists because v1 was shipped and showed me what to improve.
about.value_1_desc: I label my skills as confident, comfortable, or learning. No inflating. Recruiters deserve to know what they're actually getting.
about.value_2_desc: Every project in my portfolio was built to learn something specific — Vue 3, state management, E2E testing, algorithm correctness. Not just to fill a portfolio.
about.value_3_desc: Case studies over screenshots. Commit messages that explain why. Code comments where the why isn't obvious. I write for humans.
about.bg_intro: I come from a non-traditional background — before diving into web development, I was studying and working in a different field. The switch to programming was deliberate and took serious commitment.
about.bg_timeline_1_desc: HTML, CSS, JavaScript fundamentals. Built the first static pages. Realized this was what I wanted to do.
about.bg_timeline_2_desc: Sliding puzzle game, Fotoroman photo page. Started understanding state, components, and why frameworks exist.
about.bg_timeline_3_desc: Portfolio v1, Postly (Vue 3), first real client project (Twój Doradca). TypeScript, testing, proper architecture.
about.bg_timeline_4_desc: Ticket Dashboard, portfolio v2. App Router, i18n, E2E tests, Zod validation, CI pipeline. Building like it's going to production.
about.outside_1: Photography — I shoot landscapes and street scenes. Attention to light, composition, patience. Skills that carry over.
about.outside_2: Reading — mostly non-fiction. Systems thinking, decision-making, history of technology. Trying to understand the why behind things.
about.outside_3: Dad — father of a young daughter. Best teacher in focus, efficiency and getting things done before nap time ends.
about.contact_desc: I'm actively looking for my first professional frontend role. Open to full-time, internship, or contract work.
